speech: Folate contributes to: maternal tissue growth during pregnancy, normal amino acid synthesis, normal blood formation, normal homocysteine metabolism, normal psychological function, normal function of the immune system, the reduction of tiredness and fatigue, and has a role in the process of cell division. The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 30 micrograms of folic acid per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion.
